## The panel

::: {.abstract}
The closing panel asks where modelling and AI go next, and how
communication and collaboration fit in.
I bring the two talks from earlier in the day.
What coding agents changed in how I build outbreak models, and what we
learned communicating model outputs during COVID-19.
My guess is that agents build and check, while people keep the question,
the judgement of whether a model is fit for use, and the trust of those who
act on the numbers.
:::

The organisers asked me to join the panel at the end of the day alongside
the other speakers, moderated by Philippe Beutels of UAntwerp.

There are no slides.
The talk pages for the [keynote](../keynote/index.qmd) and the
[communication lecture](../communication/index.qmd) carry the material I am
likely to draw on.

:::
